description: Synthetic public-comment portal for one member (Dana Reyes): three fictional federal agencies, 36 proposed rules (dockets) whose comment periods are spread over 2025-01-01 to 2026-12-31 with extensions and corrections, their notices and supporting documents as UTF-8 text with a few text-based PDFs, the member's posted comments on closed dockets and one comment awaiting posting. The target docket OCDD-2026-0031 (wearable sensor data retention) closes end of day Eastern on 2026-12-04; OCDD-2026-0027 (wearable cybersecurity labeling) is the similar docket that closes later. Coverage is reported in evidence/coverage.json.

sources.description: Authored agencies, rules and notice text plus computed periods, documents and comment history; scripts/generate-fixture.cjs is the sole source and also writes the document files. Public notices were read only to mirror the structure of a rulemaking notice (summary, dates, addresses, supplementary information); no agency content, data or media was copied.

transformations: Comment periods computed per docket in the agency's time zone and closed at 23:59 local; documents rendered from the notice text; IDs, dates and references checked by validateSeed.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace a human read-through of realism and variation; recorded here before submission.
